title: A listing's page knows you're signed in again (your account bar and Back); Back to where you came from
why: Jason, 2026-11-20 (signed in, on https://traversence.com/listing/view.php?id=8916): no account bar and no way back. listing/view.php read its session from PHP's default folder, not the site's (since 2026-10-10), so every listing page showed signed-in people as guests. His answer on Back: "back to where they came from" (decisions/0058's note of 2026-11-20).

changes.what: On a listing's page, a signed-in person is signed in again: the account bar (with Back in it), and everything that depends on who you are (the admin's Edit, an owner's Manage, Claim knowing it's yours)
A listing, place or guide opened with no route (from Pulse, the admin or elsewhere on the site) shows ‹ Back to the page it came from; the Let's Explore route is unchanged
FAQ: How do I get back to where I was?
